Container.Name: IA-Video-Downloader
Container.Overview: Browse video collections on the Internet Archive (archive.org) from a simple web GUI and download individual videos or entire collections. Choose which formats to pull (h.264, MPEG4, Ogg, Matroska, originals vs. derivatives), grab subtitles, queue multiple jobs, and watch progress with pause / resume / retry. Downloads resume after restarts. Files are organised as /downloads/<collection>/<identifier>/<file>.
Container.Description: Browse and download videos from archive.org. Search for collections or individual videos, pick formats, and queue single items or whole collections for download.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns downloaded files

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns downloaded files

Config.Name: Simultaneous downloads
Config.Description: How many files to download at once (also editable in Settings)

Config.Name: Max items per collection
Config.Description: Default cap on items pulled from a collection (0 = unlimited)
